title: Which decimals lie on the line from six point four to six point six?
description: A line from 6.4 to 6.6 is cut into eight equal parts, and three letters are read by finding the size of one part first, the same way as the example in the book.
teaching_notes: One idea: eight parts do not make a tenth, so find the part size first and count from the left end. Watch for children who use ten parts.

source: Figure it Out (end of chapter), Q3
video_script.why: The child has divided lines into ten parts and now meets a line with eight.
video_script.substitution: Divide the length of the line by eight, and count the parts from the left end.
video_script.anchor: A line from 6.4 to 6.6 is cut into 8 equal parts, with three letters marked.
video_script.payoff_line: Each mark is zero point two divided by eight, which is zero point zero two five

final_answer.spoken: the letter eigh is six point four five, c is six point five two five and b is six point five five

video_script.design: One line from 6.4 to 6.6 in eight equal parts stays all video. The letters eigh, c and b sit above the 2nd, 5th and 6th marks.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; a line from 6.4 to 6.6 in 8 equal parts with three letters above it

marks.line: the line is drawn in eight equal parts

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='line'/>A line from six point four to six point six is cut into eight equal parts.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Three letters are marked on it. What decimal does each letter stand for?

beats.on_screen: the line with its three letters stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the end of the line

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: part size = length / number of equal parts; count the marks from the left end

marks.same: the line from the example in the book appears beside this one
marks.part: one part is divided out of the length
marks.count: marks are counted from the left end

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>We solve this the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='part'/>First find one part, which is the length divided by the number of parts.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Then count the marks from the left end.

beats.on_screen: Given: a line from 6.4 to 6.6 in 8 equal parts; letter a at the 2nd mark, c at the 5th, b at the 6th

marks.given: the line and its eight parts are written
marks.pos: the position of each letter is written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, a line from six point four to six point six in eight equal parts.
<bookmark mark='pos'/>The letter eigh is at the second mark. The letter c is at the fifth, and b is at the sixth.

beats.on_screen: To find: the decimal at each letter
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the decimal at each letter.

marks.len: six point six minus six point four is written
marks.part: zero point two divided by eight is written

narration: <bookmark mark='len'/>Step one, find the length. Six point six minus six point four is zero point two.
<bookmark mark='part'/>Divide it by eight parts. Zero point two divided by eight is zero point zero two five.

marks.a1: the letter eigh lights up at the second mark
marks.a2: two parts are added to six point four

narration: <bookmark mark='a1'/>Step two, the letter eigh is two parts after six point four.
<bookmark mark='a2'/>Two parts make zero point zero five. Six point four plus zero point zero five is six point four five.

marks.c1: the letter c lights up at the fifth mark
marks.c2: five parts are added to six point four

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>Step three, the letter c is five parts after six point four.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Five parts make zero point one two five. Six point four plus zero point one two five is six point five two five.

marks.b1: the letter b lights up at the sixth mark
marks.b2: six parts are added to six point four

narration: <bookmark mark='b1'/>Step four, the letter b is six parts after six point four.
<bookmark mark='b2'/>Six parts make zero point one five. Six point four plus zero point one five is six point five five.

beats.on_screen: check: 8 x 0.025 = 0.2 and 6.4 + 0.2 = 6.6, the end of the line

marks.end: the sum lands on six point six

narration: <bookmark mark='chk'/>Step five, check by putting the part size back. Eight parts of zero point zero two five make zero point two.
<bookmark mark='end'/>Six point four plus zero point two is six point six, the end of the line.

marks.vals: the three readings sit above their letters

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Each mark is zero point two divided by eight, which is zero point zero two five.
<bookmark mark='vals'/>The letter eigh is six point four five. The letter c is six point five two five, and b is six point five five.
